title: ROBIN EVO—ULTEGRA Di2
notes: Official China exact-model page supports the UHMS-EPS+ 12x142 flat-mount frame, UHMS-HPT 12x100 fork, five sizes, Ultegra R8170/R8150 2x12 factory trim and geometry. Its editorial specification states a 750 g M frame, 290 g fork and 295 g 400 mm cockpit. The public competition build may belong to a different Robin EVO generation, so these official facts are reference evidence rather than facts assigned to that custom build.
